topic: Hyogoro taught Luffy to send Armament Haki into an enemy's body
title: Hyogoro Taught Luffy The Sharper Haki
description: Hyogoro gave Luffy a sharper form of Armament Haki in Wano, and it changed how his defense became an attack. The full Haki teacher breakdown is linked above.
comment: Was Hyogoro the real second teacher, or was he only finishing a lesson Rayleigh started?

lines.text: Luffy's Armament Haki used to just cover his fists. Then Hyogoro changed that.

shot.fallback: anime style, samurai beside a young pirate in a Wano village

lines.text: Sources say Hyogoro taught Luffy to send Armament Haki into an enemy's body.

shot.fallback: anime style, samurai focusing energy into his palm

lines.text: That turns a defense into an attack, which is why this lesson matters.

shot.fallback: anime style, fist sending a shockwave through a foe

lines.text: Beebom links that internal technique to Ryuo, Hyogoro's move in Wano.

shot.fallback: anime style, samurai in a sunlit Wano courtyard

lines.text: The lesson came while Luffy was a prisoner in Udon, during the Wano arc.

shot.fallback: anime style, samurai speaking to a prisoner in a dark cell

lines.text: Rayleigh gave Luffy the foundation, but Hyogoro gave him the sharper tool.

shot.fallback: anime style, two mentors side by side with a young pirate

lines.text: Here's my read: the sharpest Haki upgrade came from a teacher people forget.

shot.fallback: anime style, calm samurai with a knowing look

lines.text: But was Hyogoro really the second teacher, or just the one who finished the lesson?

shot.fallback: anime style, samurai turning to face a young pirate

self_check.hook: Line 1 names Luffy and Armament Haki with the twist that Hyogoro changed it.
self_check.loop: The last line asks whether Hyogoro was the real second teacher, which leads back into the opening change.
